#include <iostream>
#define MOD 1000000007LL
using namespace std;

long long compute_power(int base, int exponent);

int main() {
    long long p, k, q;
    cin >> p >> k;
    q = k;
    if (k == 0) {
        cout << compute_power(p, p - 1);
        return 0;
    }
    if (k == 1) {
        cout << compute_power(p, p);
        return 0;
    }
    int n = 1;
    while (q != 1) {
        q = (q * k) % p;
        n++;
    }
    cout << compute_power(p, (p - 1) / n);
    return 0;
}

long long compute_power(int base, int exponent) {
    if (exponent == 0)
        return 1;
    long long half = compute_power(base, exponent / 2);
    long long result = (half * half) % MOD;
    if (exponent % 2 == 1) {
        result = (result * base) % MOD;
    }
    return result;
}
